description: Replace the if/elif ternary-style gating for mmfar/bfar with an equivalent helper function call, and rewrite the any_fault property's bool(self.faults) as len(self.faults) > 0; both are value-preserving rewrites (same truth table, same None-vs-int outcome for every input), so FAULTS-N4 and FAULTS-N7 hold exactly as before, and nothing else in the module is touched.

edits.find:
mmfar = mmfar_raw if (cfsr & _MMARVALID) else None
    bfar = bfar_raw if (cfsr & _BFARVALID) else None
edits.replace:
def _gated(raw_value, cfsr_word, valid_bit):
        return raw_value if (cfsr_word & valid_bit) else None

    mmfar = _gated(mmfar_raw, cfsr, _MMARVALID)
    bfar = _gated(bfar_raw, cfsr, _BFARVALID)
